check.description: Any functionality operated by a multipoint or path-based gesture (pinch, swipe, traced shape) is also operable with a single pointer without a path, unless the gesture is essential. The alternative must not itself be a dragging movement (2.5.7).

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).
